title: When the Environment Speaks: Quantum Signatures in Non-Attractor Inflation
summary: We study the open quantum dynamics of the adiabatic curvature perturbation interacting with a massive entropic scalar environment during an inflationary scenario featuring a transient Ultra-Slow-Roll phase. Working within a Gaussian two-field effective Lagrangian, we employ the exact Transport Equations Method to track the full non-unitary, non-Markovian evolution of the system's covariance matrix across the SR-USR-SR transition.
